# Royal Den Capital

> Royal Den Capital is a licensed Ontario mortgage brokerage (Mortgage Alliance, Lic. No. M25002134 / brokerage Lic. No. 10530) based in Oakville, ON. It compares Canada's top lenders to help home buyers, homeowners renewing or refinancing, and business owners secure mortgages and financing, without the runaround.

Core areas: residential mortgages (purchase, renewal, refinance), home equity products (HELOC, equity takeout, debt consolidation), specialty mortgages (reverse mortgage, new-to-Canada, second home, co-equity), construction and renovation financing, and commercial/business lending (commercial mortgages, business loans, equity financing, venture capital, SBA loans).

## Company

- [About Us](https://royaldencapital.ca/about-us/): Company background, story, and why clients choose Royal Den Capital.
- [Contact Us](https://royaldencapital.ca/contact-us/): Phone, email, and office address (Oakville, ON).
- [Careers](https://royaldencapital.ca/careers/): Opportunities for mortgage agents and brokers.

## Mortgage Solutions

- [Full Service Mortgage Solution](https://royaldencapital.ca/full-service-mortgage-solution/): Overview of all mortgage and financing services.
- [Refinance](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/refinance/): Restructure a mortgage to access equity, consolidate debt, or improve cash flow.
- [Mortgage Renewal](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/mortgage-renewal/): Compare lenders and rates at renewal instead of auto-renewing.
- [First Time Home Buyers](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/first-home-buyers/): Guidance and lender strategy for a first home purchase.
- [Equity Takeout](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/equity-takeout/): Access home equity for renovations, investments, or major expenses.
- [Home Equity Line of Credit](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/home-equity-line-credit/): Flexible secured line of credit against home equity.
- [Debt Consolidation](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/debt-consolidation/): Combine high-interest debt using home equity.
- [Renovation Finance](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/renovation-finance/): Fund a renovation project through home equity.
- [Purchase Plus Improvements](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/purchase-improvement/): Roll planned improvements into a purchase mortgage.
- [Construction Financing](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/construction-financing/): Staged-advance financing for new builds and major rebuilds.
- [Reverse Mortgage](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/reverse-mortgage/): Access home equity without regular monthly payments (eligible homeowners).
- [New to Canada Mortgage](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/new-to-canada-mortgage/): Mortgage options for newcomers with limited Canadian credit history.
- [Second Home Financing](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/second-home/): Financing for a cottage, rental, or additional property.
- [Co-Equity Homeownership](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/co-equity-homeownership-ourboro/): Shared-equity pathway to homeownership.
- [Commercial Mortgages](https://royaldencapital.ca/mortgages/commercial-mortgages/): Financing for business-use, investment, or income-generating property.
